scope: Proposed local switched-resistor shunt specification only
architecture: Proposed VSERVO -> brake resistor -> low-side NMOS -> local GND
Independent rail-derived detector/reference/driver with bounded operating supply; no MCU enable dependency

Gate pull-down provides intended off discharge only with high-impedance drive; startup/UVLO output behavior and leakage/Miller bounds remain unimplemented. Off is not protection against arriving energy.
Protection readiness must be established before exposure or an independent qualified path must cover the gap
Existing actuator qualifications remain disabled; no new permission signal or native connection is implemented

failure_requirements.open_path: No controlled sink credit; independently prevent exposure or provide a qualified backup.
failure_requirements.shorted_switch: Switch short or stuck-high drive continuously connects the resistor; bound source/reservoir current, temperature and clearing energy.
failure_requirements.shorted_resistor: Lost current limitation; switch/source/trace/fuse stress requires a separate fault assessment.
failure_requirements.absent_control_power: No guaranteed clamp; firmware disarm is not evidence that energy cannot arrive.
failure_requirements.negative_rail: Positive shunt does not establish local capacitor or remote reverse-voltage limits.
failure_requirements.invalid_sense_reference_or_driver: Classify by resulting off, on or chattering drive. A powered driver stuck high is not dominated by the gate pulldown and shares the continuous-load fault boundary.
